Question B-003-015-005.

Why the correct answer is right: FT8 signals are very narrow, allowing many separate transmissions to fit inside the spectrum used by one SSB voice signal.

Per-choice notes:
- sourceIndex 0: "Narrow bandwidth of an FT8 signal": This is the correct choice because FT8 signals are very narrow, allowing many separate transmissions to fit inside the spectrum used by one SSB voice signal.
- sourceIndex 1: "Time interleaving of the transmissions": This is a near-miss because it shifts attention from Narrow bandwidth of an FT8 signal. In digital information, packet forwarding, weak-signal modes, and sound-card drive level, it names a different cause, control, component, or safety action than the one required here.
- sourceIndex 2: "Formatting of the messages into packets": This answer would fit a different fault than Narrow bandwidth of an FT8 signal. In digital information, packet forwarding, weak-signal modes, and sound-card drive level, it names a different cause, control, component, or safety action than the one required here.
- sourceIndex 3: "Message structure with limited contact information": This option confuses another station topic with Narrow bandwidth of an FT8 signal. In digital information, packet forwarding, weak-signal modes, and sound-card drive level, it names a different cause, control, component, or safety action than the one required here.
